mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, task_id, process_instance_id, process_def_key, task_def_key, reminder_key, channel, template_code, receiver_user_ids, message_id, send_status, send_time, error_message, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time, retry_count, next_retry_time
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_flow_overdue_reminder_record SET send_status = 0, retry_count = COALESCE(retry_count, 0) + 1, next_retry_time = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND reminder_key = #{reminderKey} AND channel = #{channel} AND send_status = 2 AND COALESCE(retry_count, 0) < 5 AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_flow_overdue_reminder_record WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
